summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the Bonus mall, The Hub and authored destinations. Character progression and inventory persist in player.state, while run/story keys are mode-separated; shared gameplay, quest, appearance and prop systems are composed with place scenes and sims.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and environmental moments across streamed cells.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall, shops, homes, atlas Teleport Station, interactive props and creator/body fixtures.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads and Camp Amber; sim and helpers compose doors, destinations, crews and local interactions.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office route.
places/level1, places/level1c, places/level2, places/level21, places/level26 (3D) - procedural halls, camps, pipe halls, locked storage and authored levels.

places/level4, places/level5, places/level9, places/level10, places/level11, places/level12, places/level61, places/level70 (3D) - offices, hotel, cave, farm, city, Snackrooms and Froidetown; Level 11 includes Sedco and its quest props.

places/level114, places/level27, places/gamma, places/level169, places/level132, places/level178, places/level31 and other special levels (3D) - authored destinations, local quests/setpieces; several use awakening lighting.
places/level01, places/level02, places/level13 and remaining places/* (3D) - additional destinations with streamed cells and place-specific configuration.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered player behavior/actions; fall guard precedes movement and player behaviors attach interaction, combat, social, quest and other systems.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, static placements and generation/tick behavior; sims also run environmental and sign/surface passes.

places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js; places/level132/config.yaml + scripts/terrain132.js; places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js - seeded terrain generators and place terrain marks.
places/level169/sim.js + Level 169 helpers; places/level132/sim.js + l132 helpers - local setpieces, schedules, routes, quests/barter and population orchestration.
places/level178/sim.js + x0z0.scene - Kyoto house, residents, arrival quest, finds and containers; scripts/l178-prop.js owns futon interaction and delayed Lumiria crossing.
places/level31/sim.js + scripts/lib/level31.js and level31-{arcade,food,sideb}.js - one-time rink shell and delegated zone dressing/interaction behaviors.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/level1-geo.js + scripts/lib/wallgrid.js - Level 1 hall geometry and lamp fixtures; wallgrid supplies corridor topology.
mods/modeling-studio, mods/advanced-transform, mods/held-gizmo and mods/bodyworks - creator UI, transforms/posing and garment fitting/export; art/cat-wardrobe tools build and audit assets.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and valid atlas destinations; consumed by feed, quests and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml + scripts/lib/data/critter-faces.yml - shared player/NPC bodies, outfits, hair and painted expression faces; supports live restyle/refit.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - Bonus solo/multiplayer routing, home/atlas eligibility and Hub tunnel/door key registry.
scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - multiplayer-room detection and nonlethal NPC-down rule; scripts/player.js and scripts/meg-agent.js invoke spared().
scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data - shared usable-prop/container migration and geometry specs; scripts/interact.js dispatches.

scripts/lib/usable-kit.js + scripts/lib/data/usable-kit.json + scripts/usable-kit.js - shared usable dressing, fitted moving parts, sound/light and optional per-user gifts; sims and prop handlers reuse it.
scripts/lib/skill-check.js - shared structured/legacy dialogue check parsing, odds, banner formatting and resolution; scripts/talk-ui.js, scripts/talk.js and npc-talk.js use it.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; places/level10/sim.js and places/level21/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js - configured update handlers.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/quests.js - journal/advancement/reward helpers; scripts/lib/containment.js - pen/door operations; scripts/lib/run-opts.js - run/mode helpers and keys.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_CUTE, CAT_SLIM, SLIM_ON, CAT_SLIM_FUR, bodyGlb, catModel, catChildren, skinParams, catMorph, faceLife, liveFace; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V (sw232), furrySpec, restyle and appearance builders.

scripts/lib/skill-check.js - SKILL_NAMES, parseCheck, checkOdds, formatCheckBanner, resolveCheck; scripts/lib/level1-quests.js - rationsOutcome; scripts/lib/level10-quests.js - QUESTS10, setWheatStep, setWatcherStep, setCellarStep, finishQuest, l10Choices, handleDialogueQuest10; scripts/lib/level178-quests.js - SPOTS, QUESTS178, REWARDS, touch178, questTick178, l178Choices, handleDialogueQuest178; scripts/lib/usable-kit.js - match, seatPart, kitted, kitPass.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance/look, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates progression; modifiers, clothes and manuals data/scripts own effects and learned skills.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js - tutorial beat/cut and Field Guide state/preferences; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - trail clue flags and legacy dinaQ continuation.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texV/signTexV completion stamps.

mods/modeling-studio/player.js + god.js - world.state.m3d gallery, pending asks, shares and library snapshot; scripts/critter.js applies player/NPC look fields to rebuilt body and session animation state.

scripts/quest-prop-use.js - player.state page/read and clue flags; scripts/lib/level10-quests.js owns watcherQ and the Still Watcher quest; scripts/lib/level178-quests.js owns Kyoto quest steps plus l178GuestbookSeen/l178BoardSeen discovery memory; scripts/usable-kit.js owns prop state.kit and per-user state.kcd.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion/player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone behaviors; scripts/interact.js dispatches focused in…
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; player.js builds local first-person viewmodel and avatar through critter-model appearance builders.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js renders Continue/Start, Solo/Multiplayer and expedition/save/settings/controls links; title/pause actions → scripts/main-menu.js, which routes start and run picks.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom(party/user) → scripts/lib/hub.js toSolo → party room mp-<party> (or user room); scripts/routing.js requests Bonus solo-room selection and threshold handlers call carryAcross for held props/followers.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js multiRoom → scripts/player.js damage and scripts/meg-agent.js death handling → ordinary NPCs restored at 30% HP, stunned and shown DOWN; shootable/born-hostile/killable NPCs still die.

scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles/markers/compass; arrival → hub.noteAtlas writes player.state.atlas for Bonus Teleport Station.

Level 1 Short Rations → scripts/lib/level1-quests.js outcome → Ortiz/Jo/Sato follow-ups; page 1101 sets rationsClue. Level 3 plate → scripts/quest-prop-use.js writes l61L3Seen/XP → scripts/lib/level61-quests.js resumes Four Hundred and Thirteen at the Level 4 survey and may branch to Jo's B4 warning.

Level 11 shift note → scripts/quest-prop-use.js sets sedcoNote/page 1102 → scripts/os-ui.js offers password action → scripts/os.js runs 'login spotlight'; Sedco quest can share courier footage with Vance.

Level 10 scarecrow press can discover page 24 before the Still Watcher quest; scripts/lib/level10-quests.js lets Maeve start at the log-return step and accept its hand-in. Kyoto guestbook/go-board presses in scripts/l178-prop.js remember l178GuestbookSeen/l178BoardSeen; scripts/lib/level178-quests.js uses those flags to resume the Order and route dialogue at the next step.

scripts/lib/skill-check.js checkOdds → scripts/talk-ui.js displays actual skill odds → scripts/talk.js/npc-talk.js resolves chosen check and logs dialogue result; quest dialogue handlers consume the check result.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table and fitted chairs with paired orientatio…
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights and upgrade rolls vary by level.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/sleep.js + scripts/interact.js + scripts/rest.js + scripts/l178-prop.js - common bed detection/entry, with ordinary rest and Kyoto futon crossing as distinct outcomes.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + barter-deal.js - staged town and keeper trades use eight goods categories; first gift then balanced currency-free barter.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + scripts/mat-catskin.js + critter-faces.yml - shared player/NPC bodies, fitted garments and painted fur/hair; wardrobe and eye-shape variants by look/sex/morph, refreshed by STYLE…
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots and hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.

Tutorial finale cut ends at tut0-cut.js LEN.final = 14 s; THE WAY BACK / SOMEWHERE WET card is held over black and the crossing, then fades on Level 1 landing; retain ui.js lazy-load and main-menu.js t0lift stamp coupling.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs and destinations together. t5-a2 is OPEN to Level 178; l178-to-hub pairs with sim-created hub-from-l178.

Level 169 uses x/z, north = -z and 1:10 map scale; Level 1.1 hall distance is +X (0–620 m), north at -Z. retextureOnce waits about 8 s with a player and stamps texV; texSigns preserves sign geometry and stamps signTexV.
Furniture/model facing is authored with model.forward plus yaw; versioned sim refits update existing placements, so adjust both placement setup and migration stamps when changing fitted geometry.

Critter wardrobe refits require a STYLE_V bump in scripts/lib/critter-model.js so already standing player/NPC bodies rebuild; cat-wardrobe data and mat-catskin paint/fur depend on shared body/look parameters.
